$description: The distinctUI rules in a form tools can read. The words live in SKILL.md; check.js tests a page against these values. Light only. https://distinctui.com · MIT

palette_credits.Mzansi: The South African flag's ring colours, credited to Version One.

font.mono: ui-monospace, SF Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

rules.title: Light only
rules.text: White background, black text. No dark mode, no dark sections, no inverted hero.

rules.title: Black, white and four greys
rules.text: #000, #fff, and greys 50, 100, 200, 400, 600, 800. No blue links, no red errors, no green success, no brand gradients.

rules.title: Colour lives only on rings
rules.text: One signature colour for the product's own mark, or one palette of five when each person gets a ring. Never on buttons, links, headings, backgrounds or icons.

rules.title: One typeface
rules.text: Bricolage Grotesque for everything, including buttons and numbers. A monospace only for code.

rules.title: Headings are light with one bold word
rules.text: Weight 300 for the line, 700 for the word that carries the meaning.

rules.title: Main actions are black pills
rules.text: One black pill per group. The second action is an outlined pill. Tertiary actions are underlined text links.

rules.title: White space before borders, borders before shadows
rules.text: Separate with space first, a 1px grey-200 hairline second. The only shadow is on floating menus.

rules.title: Pills for what you press, soft corners for what you read
rules.text: Cards 22px, feature card 28px, panels 16px, long-form inputs 14px.

rules.title: Dashed until live
rules.text: The mark is dashed while the thing it stands for isn't out yet, solid once it ships, with a small black version label.

rules.title: Errors are black and bold
rules.text: With a small black ! disc, saying which field and how to fix it. Never red.

rules.title: Hover is a black edge, not a lift
rules.text: No scale, no shadow, no glow on hover. Motion only says what changed, runs once, and switches off for reduced motion.

rules.title: Write plainly
rules.text: Buttons say what happens. Errors name the field and the fix. No jokes in errors, no exclamation marks.

left_out.toast: No toasts. Show a dui-status notice where the person is looking, and leave it there.
left_out.carousel: No carousels. Use a grid, rows or a gallery so nothing is hidden.
left_out.popup: No popups on arrival. Use a form section or an announcement line.
left_out.spinner: No page spinners. Use dui-skeleton loading shapes after 300ms.
